title: Feature and settings review interactions
summary: This topic centers on requests or mentions of reviewing vehicle features, phone or navigation settings, and dealer or writer follow-up rather than a single clearly rated ownership issue.

positive.summary: One review positively asks for a free walkthrough to confirm efficient use of the vehicle’s features.

undetermined.summary: The undetermined reviews mostly note that a dealer, writer, or customer would review settings, features, or an affected area without enough sentiment to classify the experience.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are procedural notes about reviewing settings or follow-up actions, so sentiment is largely not explicit.
The examples mix feature walkthroughs, iPhone settings, navigation configuration, dealer follow-up, and inspection notes rather than one tightly coherent issue.
There is only one clearly positive example and no clearly negative, mixed, or neutral examples, so concrete sentiment-specific themes are limited.
